medidas.frase_do_ganho: What full-time employees on full pay earn per month, on average, before deductions, from the staff records of the labour ministry’s strategy and planning office.
medidas.leitura: Évora’s council owes less than the law allows, and its debt index has fallen to less than half in ten years: from 242,6%source · calculated in 2014 to 105,5%source · calculated in 2024.
